summary: Candidate is a distinct micro-skill for single-step agent execution with structured response capture. It does not semantically match existing skills (which cover zone scoring, Flink job execution, nested operations, stream event processing, and test dependencies). The candidate addresses a specific agent interaction pattern (step invocation and response handling) not covered by the registry. Peer candidates represent orthogonal concerns (nested operations, event streaming, test orchestration) and do not subsume this skill.
